description: Implementation of WNFileLocations class managing file location paths for Wesnoth Scenario Editor, including initialization and getter/setter methods for various resource paths.

classes.name: WNFileLocations
classes.description: Manages file location paths for resources used in Wesnoth Scenario Editor, including initialization and accessors for resource directories.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes resource location paths based on app bundle structure.

methods.name: unitDataLoc
methods.description: Returns the units data directory path.

methods.name: terrainImageLoc
methods.description: Returns the terrain images directory path.

methods.name: getSaveLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the current save location path.

methods.name: setExportDataLocation
methods.description: Sets the export data directory path.

methods.name: getExportDataLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the export data directory path.

methods.name: setExportUnitsLocation
methods.description: Sets the export units directory path.

methods.name: getExportUnitsLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the export units directory path.

methods.name: setExportScenariosLocation
methods.description: Sets the export scenarios directory path.

methods.name: getExportScenariosLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the export scenarios directory path.

methods.name: setExportImagesLocation
methods.description: Sets the export images directory path.

methods.name: getExportImagesLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the export images directory path.
